name: device-adaptation-engine
description: Device Adaptation + Real Device Preview Engine - upload one mobile design, render and validate it across a data-driven device catalog.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dae/shared build && pnpm --filter @dae/device-catalog build && pnpm --filter @dae/engine build && pnpm --filter @dae/api build && pnpm --filter @dae/worker build && pnpm --filter @dae/web build
scripts.build:standalone: pnpm --filter @dae/shared build && pnpm --filter @dae/device-catalog build && pnpm --filter @dae/engine build && pnpm --filter @dae/web build:standalone
scripts.build:artifact: pnpm build:standalone && node apps/web/scripts/to-artifact.mjs apps/web/dist-standalone/index.html apps/web/dist-standalone/artifact.html
